method: Actual unchanged _build_confidence_calibration function on disposable SQLite tables, real SQLAlchemy Row projection and real eligibility helper. One fixture demonstrates loss before publication sample-floor checks.

limitations: Outcomes from different model and rule generations are pooled: `signal_outcomes` stores no model or policy version, so a rate here spans every generation active in the window.
A measured hit rate over the underlying is not a calibrated probability, and says nothing about the return after costs.
